description: Astronomers have discovered a striking shockwave around the white dwarf RXJ0528+2838, a finding that contradicts existing theories. Observed using the Very Large Telescope, the structure suggests a long-lasting outflow from a system thought to be inactive. The mystery points to an unknown energy source shaping how dead stars interact with space.
title: Astronomers Find ‘Mystery Engine’ Powering Massive Nebula Around a Dead Star, Challenging Physics

description: Space Gen: Chandrayaan is coming to OTT soon. One of the greatest achievements in global history was realised when India became the first nation to land a spacecraft on the lunar south pole, at the site named Statio Shiv Shakti. This series chronicles that mission, highlighting how it ultimately succeeded after an initial setback. It is a powerful story of resilience, strength, and intelligence. Let’s dive in to find out the release date and the star-studded cast.
title: Space Gen: Chandrayaan OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Nakuul Mehta, Shriya Saran Starrer Online?

description: SpaceX successfully launched 29 Starlink satellites on January 12, 2026, aboard a reused Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral. The mission marked SpaceX’s fifth launch of the year and demonstrated booster reuse, with the first stage landing on the drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas. After a long coast phase, the upper stage deployed the satellites into low Earth orbit, further expanding SpaceX’s rapidly growing global broadband internet constellation.
title: SpaceX Launches 29 New Starlink Satellites as Reused Falcon 9 Booster Ties Flight Record

description: Astronomers have observed a completely dark mysterious object, which is approximately a million times more massive than the mass of the Sun. It is found about 11 billion light-years distant and was identified in 2025 through its gravitational impact on the light of a background galaxy. This renders it the farthest object ever to have been observed by pure gravity. Scientists believe that it might be a new form of universe structure altogether.
title: Astronomers Find ‘Dark Object’ 11 Billion Light-Years Away Through Gravity

description: Gimbap and Onigiri is a Japanese romance drama series that revolves around the romance between a Korean animation student and a local part-time worker, as the two connect through food. The series is currently streaming on Netflix, with its first episode having premiered on January 12, 2026. The series stars Eiji Akaso as Hase Taiga and Kang Hye-won as Park Rin in the lead roles.
title: Gimbap and Onigiri Streaming on Netflix: Everything About Eiji Akaso, Kang Hye-won’s Romance Drama

description: Apple launched the iOS 26.3 beta 2 for developers earlier this week. The codes spotted on the software version indicate that RCS messaging may soon be available to iPhone models with end-to-end encryption (E2EE). Apple announced E2EE support for RCS messaging in March last year in association with GSMA. Support for E2EE will ensure that messages and content will remain safe and secure, and the service providers wont be able to access them.
title: Apple's iOS 26.3 Beta 2 Update Hints at End-to-End Encryption Support for RCS Messaging: Report

description: Arc Raiders has crossed 12.4 million copies sold across platforms, publisher Nexon and developer Embark Studios have confirmed. The hit extraction shooter also reached close to a million concurrent players in January. Arc Raiders' Update 1.11.0 is now rolling out on all platforms, as well.
title: Arc Raiders' Sales Cross 12.4 Million Copies as Embark Studios Rolls Out New Update

description: India’s sub-Rs. 3,000 TWS segment now offers strong sound, active noise cancellation, long battery life, and app support that once belonged only to premium models. Options like Oppo Enco Buds 3 Pro+, Skullcandy Jib True 2, Redmi Buds 6, OnePlus Nord Buds 3 Pro, and Boat Nirvana Zenith Pro cover a wide range of everyday uses, from gaming and video streaming to calls, workouts, and commuting. Across these earbuds, you get large drivers, up to 50dB noise cancellation, spatial audio, fast charging, and IP-rated designs, making them some of the best-value picks right now.
title: Best Earbuds Under Rs 3,000 in India: Oppo Enco Buds 3 Pro+, Redmi Buds 6 and More

description: If you are looking for a smartphone in India with an AMOLED display, there are several great options in all price segments. Top options include Redmi Note 15 5G, Oppo Reno 15 Pro 5G, Samsung Galaxy A56 5G, OnePlus 15, and Realme GT 8 Pro. You can make the final purchase decision after considering other key specifications like the battery life,  processors, software versions, camera performance and durability.
title: Best Smartphones Available in India With AMOLED Displays: Redmi Note 15 5G, Oppo Reno 15 Pro, More

description: iPhone 17 was launched globally, including in India, in September 2025, along with the iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone Air. The handset was unveiled in India at a starting price of Rs. 82,900 for the base 256GB storage variant. However, now customers can buy Apple’s smartphone at a discounted price during the Flipkart Republic Day Sale 2026 Early Bird Deals. While the sale event will start in the country on January 17, the company has begun teasing deals and offers on electronics from different categories.
title: iPhone 17 Price in India Drops Under Rs. 75,000 Ahead of Flipkart Republic Day Sale 2026

description: Unlike the MX Master 3S, Logitech’s flagship mouse comes with all the usual bells and whistles one would expect from a premium productivity mouse and some more. While it appears and feels largely familiar, the mouse is brand-new in more ways than one. Design aside, there are some new features and some hardware changes as well, but do they add up? Or does it pack too many unnecessary features? Read on to find out!
title: Logitech MX Master 4 Review: New Features, New Price

description: Qubo has launched two new car accessories in India, dubbed Dashcam Live 4G and Dashcam Trio. Both dashcams are currently available in the country via the Qubo India online store at discounted prices. The two new dashcams are capable of recording up to 2K resolution videos, offering a 140-degree field of view. The Qubo Dashcam Trio sports a 3.2-inch IPS LCD screen, which displays the camera feed. The Qubo Dashcam 4G Live, on the other hand, offers real-time vehicle tracking through the Qubo Pro app.
title: Qubo Dashcam 4G Live Launched in India With Live GPS Tracking, Safety Alerts Alongside Dashcam Trio: Price, Features

description: Slack has worked the entire last year on upgrading its enterprise-focused communication and collaboration platform with agentic artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. One of the biggest announcements was made in October 2025, when the Salesforce-owned company revealed its plans to evolve Slack into a personal agent that works on a conversational interface.
title: Slack Introduces Agentic AI: How the New Slackbot Automates Your Workflow

description: Vivo V70 series has surfaced in a fresh leak, suggesting that its India launch could take place soon. The lineup could comprise two models, the vanilla Vivo V70 and the Vivo V70 Elite. They are said to come with Qualcomm chipsets, Zeiss-branded cameras and Sony sensors. The Vivo V70 is likely to run on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset. It could come in a 12GB RAM and 256GB storage configuration
title: Vivo V70 Series India Launch Timeline Leaked; Two Models Expected to Debut

description: Crypto markets traded sideways on Tuesday as investors waited for US inflation data that could influence Federal Reserve policy. Bitcoin held near the $91,000 level, with analysts pointing to stabilising ETF flows and reduced retail participation. Ethereum stayed firm above $3,000, while altcoins showed mixed movement amid thin liquidity and a risk-off mood across global markets.
title: Bitcoin Price Hovers Around $91,000 as Inflation Data Keeps Traders on Edge

description: Capcom has announced Resident Evil showcase for this week, featuring the latest update on Resident Evil Requiem. The showcase will be broadcast on YouTube and Twitch on January 15. Resident Evil Requiem is set for launch across PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Nintendo Switch 2 on February 27.
title: Capcom Announces Resident Evil Showcase for January 15

description: Google is rolling out a new batch of 20 starters, conditions, and actions in the Google Home app to give users more control and customise their actions. The update allows users to automate actions like media playback, appliance control, and security systems. It includes actions to open or close smart blinds, and perform resume, pause or dock actions with the robot vacuum. More Google Home automation features are confirmed to be in the works, and they will be available in the coming weeks.
title: Google Home App Update Introduces Improved Automations for Smart Home Devices

description: iQOO Z11 Turbo's front-facing camera details teased ahead of official launch. The rear camera unit of the phone will have a 200-megapixel main camera with a 1/1.56-inch sensor. It is confirmed to come with Global Esports Network System 2.0 for enhanced connectivity. It will ship with the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and boast a 6.59-inch display. It will have an IP69-rated build.
title: iQOO Z11 Turbo Selfie Camera Details Teased Ahead of January 15 Launch

title: Ithiri Neram Out on OTT: Know Where to Watch This Romance Film Online

description: NoiseFit Pro 6R has been launched in India by the Gurugram-headquartered tech firm. The company unveiled its new smartwatch in three strap variants, dubbed Leather, Metal, and Silicone. Each strap model is offered in distinct colour options, too. The smartwatch is currently on sale in the country via Amazon, Flipkart, and the Noise India online store. The tech firm claims that the NoiseFit Pro 6R will provide up to 30 days of standby time and up to seven days of battery backup.
title: NoiseFit Pro 6R Launched in India With Up to 7 Days of Battery Life, Built-In GPS Support: Price, Features

The series benefits from strong social media discussions, fan reactions, and reviews surrounding Netflix’s live-action adaptation. High viewership, positive audience response, and ratings contribute to the series’ popularity.
title: One Piece: Into The Grand Line Season 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: In a post on X (formerly known as Twitter), the official handle of OpenAI announced the acquisition of Torch, adding, “Bringing this together with ChatGPT Health opens up a new way to understand and manage your health.” In addition to purchasing the startup, the AI giant is also onboarding the entire staff of Torch, which comprises four people.
title: OpenAI Acquires HealthTech Startup Torch, Plans to Integrate It With ChatGPT Health

description: Oppo has confirmed that the Oppo A6c will launch in China on January 15. Teaser images show the phone in purple and green with a vertically stacked dual-camera module that closely resembles the Oppo A6x 5G, suggesting it may be a rebranded version for China. Oppo has not revealed specifications yet, but if it is based on the A6x 5G, it could feature a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and a 6,500mAh battery with fast charging.
title: Oppo A6c China Launch Date Announced; Company Reveals Design, Colour Options

description: Oppo Find N6 will be the first foldable smartphone to be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core 3nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a tipster claims. The development of the handset is completed, the leaker added. Additionally, the phone is said to carry a 200-megapixel primary rear camera. The key specifications of the Oppo Watch X3 have also surfaced online, along with its colour options. The smartwatch is said to feature 2GB of RAM and 32GB of onboard storage. It might ship with eSIM support and pack a 632mAh battery.
title: Oppo Find N6 Camera Configuration Tipped Alongside Oppo Watch X3 Specifications, Colourways

description: Apple and Google have announced a multi-year AI partnership that will bring Google’s Gemini technology into Apple Intelligence and power the long-delayed advanced Siri. While Apple says its privacy standards will remain intact, the deal has raised questions about how user data will be handled. Clearer details are expected closer to Siri’s rollout later this year.
title: Privacy Concerns With Gemini-Powered Siri? This Is What Apple and Google Say

description: The Realme Neo 8 is set to debut in China soon, and its launch date has been announced. The handset is expected to arrive as the successor to the Realme Neo 7, which was introduced in December 2024. Ahead of its launch, the company has several details about the handset. It is confirmed to be equipped with a display sourced from Samsung’s display manufacturing division, supporting a refresh rate of up to 165Hz.
title: Realme Neo 8 Launch Date in China Announced After Company Confirms 165Hz Samsung Display

description: Realme is reportedly preparing to launch another P series smartphone in India. The handset, with a 10,000mAh battery, has been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification website with the model number RMX5107. However, the name of the mysterious handset and other details about it, including launch timeline, specifications, features, and colour options, remain under wraps. This comes soon after the Realme P4x 5G was launched in India with a 7,000mAh battery and MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset.
title: Realme P Series Phone With 10,000mAh Battery Spotted on BIS Website; Could Launch in India Soon

description: Samsung Galaxy A07 5G has been quietly launched in Thailand as a new 5G smartphone. It features a 6.7-inch HD+ 120Hz LCD, a 6nm octa-core chipset, up to 6GB RAM, and 128GB storage expandable via microSD. The phone runs Android 16 with One UI 8.0 and is promised six years of updates. It includes a 50-megapixel dual rear camera, an 8-megapixel selfie camera, a 6,000mAh battery with 25W charging, and an IP54-rated build.
title: Samsung Galaxy A07 5G Launched With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Main Camera: Price, Features

description: The Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 is rumoured to be in development as the successor to the Galaxy Z Flip 7, which was launched in August 2025. While the handset is expected to come with several upgrades, including the new Exynos 2600 chip, it may not receive any meaningful camera improvements. According to a report, the purported handset will feature similar camera specifications as the current model, including the ultra-wide-angle and selfie shooters.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 to Reportedly Miss Out on Major Camera Upgrades; Specifications Leak

description: Tata Motors has given its popular micro-SUV, the Tata Punch, a fresh update with the launch of its first-ever facelift. The new Tata Punch Facelift is offered in six variants - Smart, Pure, Pure+, Adventure, Accomplished and Accomplished+ S. Prices for the updated micro-SUV start at Rs 5.59 lakh (ex-showroom).
title: Tata Punch 2026 Facelift Launched with Major Tech Upgrades and Updated Design: Price, Booking Details

title: Amazon Great Republic Day Sale 2026 Deals and Discounts on Laptops, Tablets, and Smart TVs Revealed

description: Google and Apple announced a multi-year collaboration on Monday. This move will see the Mountain View-based tech giant’s Gemini artificial intelligence (AI) models and cloud technology power the next generation of Apple Foundation Models. The two tech behemoths will collaborate to power upcoming features part of the Apple Intelligence suite, including a more advanced and personalised version of Siri, which has been on the cards for some time now but is yet to be rolled out.
title: Apple Taps Google’s Gemini AI Models to Power Personalised Version of Siri and Apple Intelligence

description: Apple captured the top spot in the global smartphone shipments in 2025, according to a report by Counterpoint Research. The global trends also witnessed a year-on-year (YoY) growth of two percent in the preceding year, making it the second year in a row that brands expanded their sell-in numbers. The report highlighted that Samsung came in the second spot after capturing 19 percent of the market.
title: Apple Took the Top Spot as Global Smartphone Shipments Rose 2 Percent YoY in 2025: Counterpoint

description: Call of Duty could finally be making its way to Nintendo platforms. A dataminer has found references to Nintendo within the code of a recent Call of Duty update, suggesting that Call of Duty could release on Nintendo Switch 2 soon.
title: Call of Duty Could be Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Soon

description: CMF Headphone Pro has been launched in India at a price of Rs. 7,999, but will be available at an exclusive launch price of Rs. 6,999, starting January 20. It will be sold via Flipkart and select offline retail stores. Active noise cancellation on the headphones can cut out up to 40dB of background sound, with multiple intensity levels to choose from. Audio is handled by 40mm drivers with support for LDAC and Hi-Res formats, while battery life is rated at up to 100 hours, or about 50 hours with ANC enabled, with fast charging over USB Type-C.
title: CMF Headphone Pro Launched in India With 40mm Drivers, Energy Slider and 100-Hour Battery Life

description: Honor Magic 8 Pro Air is set to be launched in China by the smartphone maker on January 19 at 7:30pm local time (5pm IST). title: Honor Magic 8 Pro Air Chipset, Battery, Other Details Leaked via Unboxing Video Ahead of Launch
